# <span class="span_generic">Welcome!</span>

![](img/bulldog.png){style="float:right;padding: 0 0px 0px 0px;border-radius:10%" width="250"}

\

#### We're a new lab <u>*opening January 2027*</u> in the [Department of Genetics](https://www.genetics.uga.edu/) at the University of Georgia.


#### We use **model systems**, **DNA sequencing**, and new **computational methods** to study mutation rate evolution.
